body.x: robox(www.cel-robox.com) unveiled '3D printer' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It's includes a dual-nozzle system which closes the flow of material and lifts the unused nozzle. Up to 300% faster than our competitors. And one of the highest print resolutions of - 20µm (0.02mm) layers. Also plug in the power and USB cord and printing automated bed levelling, intuitive software and advanced hardware all make reliable and easy to use.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
